kicker: LEDGER · Wednesday 21 October · the street, the first piece from the cloud's kit
title: Lamp post C in the street
how: Shortfalls first: at night each column's road face burns to a bright yellow stripe under its own lamp, and from directly below the lamp tube inside the bowl reads as one pale rod (both set aside after two tries each; a fix that cured the stripe left Mickey's window dark, so it was undone). The concrete is still clean for 1990 (the wear layer comes later in your order) and the number plate is blank.

The cloud's concrete lamp column now stands at the street's four lamp spots in place of the old dark steel one, with the kit's new shared materials (concrete grain from the street's own photograph, a yellowed acrylic bowl). Each view passed one fresh reviewer; the reviews found old lamp parts left standing, concrete reading as white plastic, an invisible bowl and a column glaring under its own light, each fixed (the pool now leans out over the road). Taken today in the game at 2560 by 1440.
foot: Nothing bought or signed up for. Anything you do not pick carries onto the next page.

sections.name: The street's lamp columns: concrete or black steel?
sections.note: The cloud built precast concrete as the main kind (its photographs of such streets show pale concrete columns with square arms) and kept a black painted steel column as the written-out alternative; both share the arm, the lantern and the light. Your Hook sheet shows no lamp column, and the old stand-in was dark steel. Concrete reads paler in the street.
